name: Spectral Aura
description: Spectral Aura allows you to step between the veil of life and death to protect yourself and hinder your Foes.  Many Spectral Aura powers cause additional effects when used on feared foes.

powers.name: Spectral Shift
powers.description: You partially shift yourself out of the living world to avoid the strikes of your foes. While active Melee attacks may harmlessly pass through you, you also gain resistance to negative energy damage and increased movement speed. Recharge: Fast
powers.shortHelp: Toggle: Self +DEF(Melee), Res(Negative Energy, DeBuff DEF), Run Speed

powers.name: Phantasmal Phase
powers.description: You futher phase out of the physical realm, while active enemy ranged and area of effect attacks may harmlessly pass through you. you also gain increased resistance to negative energy damage and increased jump height and control. Recharge: Fast
powers.shortHelp: Toggle: Self +DEF(Ranged, AoE), Res(Negative Energy, DeBuff DEF), Jump

powers.name: Spectral Shroud
powers.description: You shroud yourself in spectral forces which may intercept some of your foes attacks while also allowing you to pass through most entities. While the shroud is active you are protected from Sleep, Fear, Hold and Disorient attacks. Recharge: Fast
powers.shortHelp: Toggle: Self+ Absorb, Self+ Intangible, Self +Res(Immobilize, Sleep, Hold, Disorient, Fear, Confuse, Knock)

powers.name: Visions Of The End
powers.description: You cause your enemies to be subjected to visions of their untimely demise, fearing targets in an area around you. While this power is active you also gain an aura that causes fear to targets near you and your attacks gain the ability to inflict additional fear when striking a foe. Recharge: long
powers.shortHelp: Click: PBAoE Foe Fear, Foe Fear Proc

powers.name: Convalesce
powers.description: Your weakened link to the world of the living allows you to instantly recover from wounds. Activing this power near a feared target drains their energy while restoring yours. Recharge: Long

powers.name: Frightening Fade
powers.description: You create a burst of spectral energy, causing spirits to distract and placate your foes so they can no longer find or target you.  Recharge: Slow

powers.name: Haunting Haze
powers.description: You're able to cause a fracture in the barrier between life and death in an area around you, this haze causes foes to have reduced perception radius and be slowed by the chilling forces of death. Feared targets within the area suffer from reduced damage and resistances. Recharge: Moderate

powers.name: Quick Recovery
powers.description: You recover Endurance at a faster rate than normal. This power is always on.

powers.name: Beyond The Veil
powers.description: Your Mastery of skirting the edges of life and death enable you to defy death for a short time, rendering you untouchable while boosting your recovery. Using this power while defeated will revive you. Recharge: Very Long
